name: Ninety Second Year
loop: A masked year of four assets plays in 90 seconds. Set weights with sliders, rebalance twice, then the reveal scores return per unit of drawdown.
hook: A whole year in a breath; the second run tempts you to fix your sizing.
risk: Frictionless unlimited replays could feel like gambling practice; label paper only.

name: Stop Placement Gauntlet
loop: Five masked charts in a row. Drag a stop line and a target line before each plays out; survive all five with equity above the floor to unlock harsher volatility modifiers.
hook: Each run teaches where stops get hunted; modifiers raise the stakes.
risk: Teaches stop habits that may not transfer; add a not-advice banner.

name: Hold Or Fold
loop: A paper position opens on a masked chart and plays forward in jumps. At each pause swipe right to hold or left to fold; the longer winners are held and losers cut, the higher the score.
hook: Pure disposition-effect trainer; each pause is a small tense choice.
risk: Pause cadence resembles slot-machine reward timing.

name: Drawdown Survivor
loop: Generated market regimes hit a paper portfolio. Reallocate between assets as shocks arrive; the run ends when drawdown passes 25 percent. Score is time survived times final return.
hook: A clear fail line gives every run a story of how it died.
risk: Synthetic regimes may teach false patterns; label clearly as synthetic.

name: Kelly Dial
loop: Twelve masked setups. For each, set a win probability; the app sizes a paper bet from your stated edge. Scoring is log growth of the bankroll, so overconfidence is punished.
hook: Overbetting visibly bankrupts you; calibration becomes the game.
risk: Sizing formulas may be read as advice; present as an educational toy.

name: Four Chart Spread
loop: Four masked charts load side by side. Split 100 paper points across them, watch a compressed quarter, then the reveal shows how correlation helped or hurt your split.
hook: Diversification discovered by feel, then explained by the reveal.
risk: Correlation lessons rest on a small sample; avoid claiming universal rules.

name: Ruin Roulette Reversed
loop: Hold to ride a rising synthetic curve, release to lock the gain. Each stage hides a crash point; between stages pick a relic that changes risk. Race the ghost of a friend's best run.
hook: Cash-out tension plus relics gives roguelike variety.
risk: Hold-to-ride is crash-game mechanics; high compulsion risk.

name: Time Lapse Bear
loop: A masked bear market replays in four chapters. At each chapter choose to trim, hold or add paper exposure; the ending reveals the period and your drawdown versus a passive hold.
hook: Lived experience of a drawdown without the pain; the codex logs each regime.
risk: Replaying real crises may be insensitive; keep tone neutral.

name: Loss Budget
loop: You get a fixed loss budget of 10 paper points. Place up to five positions, each with a stop; total worst case must fit the budget. Score is gain per budget point actually used.
hook: A puzzle about risk first, returns second.
risk: Constraint puzzles may be read as a risk model recommendation.

name: Equity Curve Painter
loop: Drag weights live while a masked year scrolls past; your equity curve draws itself and gets colored by how smooth it is. Share a card of the curve with no tickers shown.
hook: The smoothness paint makes risk visible and brag-worthy.
risk: Optimizing for pretty curves may encourage overfitting a past path.

name: Margin Of Safety Run
loop: Each floor is a masked month. Keep a cash reserve slider; spare cash earns a floor bonus but idle cash loses to the market. Descend five floors without hitting zero cash buffer.
hook: Cash is a resource like health; tradeoffs on every floor.
risk: Energy limits may push return visits; keep energy generous.

name: Rebalance Rhythm
loop: A masked decade of three assets plays in 150 seconds. Tap on the beat to rebalance back to target weights; fewer, better-timed rebalances beat constant tinkering.
hook: Rhythm-game feel teaches that restraint pays.
risk: Rhythm taps may blur into frequency rewards; score must not reward activity.

name: Pre Mortem
loop: Before a masked trade plays, name the single biggest way it could fail from five options. After the replay, the app scores whether your named risk is the one that hit.
hook: Trains risk thinking; reveals how surprises usually arrive.
risk: Answer key from one path is thin evidence; frame as one example.

name: Tail Risk Tango
loop: Two players get the same hidden synthetic path with a shock inside. Each sets weights blind; whoever ends higher after a time-compressed run wins the point, with drawdown as tiebreak.
hook: Same shock, two philosophies; instant story to tell.
risk: Win-lose framing between strangers may encourage reckless sizing.

name: Volatility Thermostat
loop: One slider sets how much paper exposure to hold as volatility swings on a generated path. Keep realized portfolio swings inside a target band; score is time spent in the band.
hook: Like steering a boat; quietly teaches risk targeting.
risk: Volatility targeting may be taken as a recommended method.

name: Pyramid Or Not
loop: A winning masked position offers to add size at each new high. Swipe right to add, left to stand pat. Adding raises both payoff and ruin chance; three runs a day feed a friends league.
hook: Greed versus patience in a single repeated gesture.
risk: Adding to winners rewards leverage-like behavior; cap sizes.

name: Correlation Cards
loop: Draft five masked asset cards from a pool of ten, shown only as shapes of past behavior. A time-compressed year runs; decks whose cards fall together on the same days lose a risk bonus.
hook: Deck building where synergy means anti-correlation.
risk: Card shapes could leak the asset identity; keep reveals after play.

name: Bleed Or Bail
loop: A masked position is already down. Hold the button to stay in as time compresses; release to exit. Score compares your exit with the best and worst exit points on that path.
hook: A tight emotional beat: how long can you stand it.
risk: Teaches holding losers if path recovers; show losing counterexamples too.

name: Sector Sweeper
loop: Everyone gets the same weekly masked basket of six assets and one compressed year. Allocate once, rebalance up to twice, and rank by risk-adjusted return among all players.
hook: A weekly shared puzzle with comparable scores.
risk: Leaderboards reward lucky outcomes; show confidence ranges.

name: Insurance Slot
loop: Each round you pay paper points to protect part of the portfolio against a crash, or skip it and keep the cost. Crashes arrive on a hidden schedule; the scorecard shows cost of insurance versus losses avoided.
hook: Insurance feels wasteful until the crash; the game feels that tension.
risk: Might nudge toward derivatives talk; keep it abstract and paper-only.

name: Position Size Tournament
loop: Direction is given for you each day on a masked chart; your only decision is a size slider. Season standings accumulate across days, so steady sizing beats bold swings.
hook: Isolates sizing skill so entries cannot be blamed.
risk: Given direction may read as a signal; the direction must be random.

name: Ghost Of Drawdown Past
loop: Replay an anonymised verified trader's sequence of closed trades as a story. At each point swipe to guess whether the next trade closed up or down, while a drawdown meter tracks the trader's equity.
hook: Ties the game to real verified records and shows how streaks look from inside.
risk: Anonymised records could be re-identified; use coarse buckets only.

name: Concentration Dial
loop: One dial runs from one big bet to twenty small ones across masked names. Spin it, replay a year, and see a histogram of outcomes from many alternate years at your dial setting.
hook: One dial, instant intuition about concentration.
risk: Alternate-year histograms from limited data may overstate confidence.

name: Averaging Down Trap
loop: A story of one masked position that keeps falling. At each dip swipe to add paper size or hold. The ending reveals whether adding rescued or ruined the account, then replays with the opposite choices.
hook: Counterfactual replay gives a clear lesson in either direction.
risk: Both outcomes exist in history; avoid framing one as right.

name: Risk Parity Puzzle
loop: Today's puzzle gives five assets with known swing sizes. Set weights so each contributes equal risk; the check is exact, and a short replay shows the portfolio ride.
hook: A satisfying solvable puzzle with a shareable grid.
risk: Presents one method as correct; call it a puzzle, not a strategy.

name: Gap Night
loop: Each day in a masked stretch ends with a decision to hold paper exposure overnight. Stops cannot protect against gaps, and a few gap days wreck careless runs. Reach day thirty alive.
hook: Learn gap risk in your gut; each run ends dramatically.
risk: Overnight framing may be confused with real overnight holding advice.

name: Bankroll Marathon
loop: A long chain of 40 quick coin-like paper bets with your stated edge. Choose size each time; the bankroll compounds. Leaderboard shows median finish, not the best, to discourage hero bets.
hook: Survival over many rounds; median ranking changes behavior.
risk: Chained bet UI is casino-like; keep prices market-shaped, not odds.

name: Trailing Stop Lab
loop: Pick a trailing stop distance on a slider and watch it run across ten masked paths at once. A summary compares captured gain to the total move, showing the trade-off between tight and loose.
hook: Ten parallel replays make the trade-off tangible in seconds.
risk: Ten paths is a small sample; show it as illustration.

name: Risk Of Ruin Race
loop: Race a ghost whose sizing is secretly a previous player's. Both start with equal paper capital on the same path. Whoever survives longer with more equity wins, then see both size curves.
hook: Asynchronous race against real human sizing behaviors.
risk: Ghost data stores player decisions; keep it anonymous.

name: Basket Of Bets
loop: Eight masked charts arrive as cards. Swipe right to include in the basket, left to skip, limited to five slots. A compressed quarter plays; scoring rewards diversification as well as return.
hook: Familiar swipe gesture gives a portfolio-building loop.
risk: Swipe mimics feed swiping and could blur into the real feed; style differently.

name: Black Swan Budget
loop: Each level has a hidden rare shock. Hold a hedge allocation as a fraction of paper capital; if the shock never hits, hedge cost shows. Pick relics that change shock odds and escalate.
hook: Rare events create memorable dramatic runs.
risk: Hedging flavor might read as advice; keep synthetic and labeled.

name: Drawdown Bingo
loop: Over a compressed masked year tap whenever you think the drawdown from the peak has reached its worst point. Scoring is how close you were to the real low, in percent of the range.
hook: Calling the bottom is impossible; the miss is the lesson.
risk: Might encourage bottom-calling; show how rarely anyone nails it.

name: Tilt Meter
loop: After each paper loss a tilt meter rises and decisions are timed shorter. Calm play restores it. Score weights decisions made under tilt, so staying disciplined after losses earns more.
hook: Gamifies emotional discipline instead of picking.
risk: Pressure design could induce real stress; add a pause button.

name: Allocation Autopsy
loop: Read an anonymised verified trader's record summarized as sizing buckets and loss clusters, then choose which factor best explains the drawdown. The answer card explains how to read such records.
hook: Teaches how to read profiles in the real app.
risk: Record-reading may drift toward evaluating individuals; use anonymised composites.

name: Timeline Squeeze
loop: Hold a button to stay invested while a decade squeezes into 120 seconds; release to sit in cash. Your invested time bar and equity curve are compared with always-invested at the reveal.
hook: Makes market timing feel as tempting and futile as it is.
risk: Hold-to-ride repeated play is compulsion-prone; run once per cooldown.

name: Drawdown Dungeon
loop: Each room is a masked market month with a hazard type. Choose gear such as lower sizing, wider stops or cash. Reach the exit with portfolio drawdown under the limit; clear rooms unlock new gear.
hook: Classic dungeon structure wrapped around risk tools.
risk: Gear metaphors can trivialize losses; keep paper-only notice.

name: Two Account Split
loop: Divide capital into a safe account and a risky account, then play both through a compressed year. Score blends total growth with worst-month loss, so the split ratio is the whole skill.
hook: One decision, deep consequences, trivial to share as a link.
risk: Safe versus risky labels might read as advice on real allocations.

name: Stop Hunt Detective
loop: See a masked chart up to now. Drag the range inside which price will stay over the next stretch, then the path plays. Score rewards ranges that are tight yet hold, informing where stops fit.
hook: Interval prediction doubles as stop placement training.
risk: Tight range reward could encourage luck; use proper coverage scoring.

name: Compounding Cliff
loop: Choose a constant fraction to commit each period and run a thousand compressed periods on generated paths. Watch the bankroll curve climb then collapse past the sweet spot.
hook: Visceral cliff edge discovered by sliding too far.
risk: Might be read as a leverage-sizing recommendation; keep abstract.

name: Hot Streak Hazard
loop: Early wins arrive by design on generated paths; the game tempts you to increase size after streaks. A late reversal punishes oversizing. Scoring reads your size change after wins versus losses.
hook: A mirror for overconfidence with a clear debrief.
risk: Rigged-feeling paths may erode trust; disclose the design.

name: Fund Of One Season
loop: A season is eight weekly masked quarters. Carry paper capital across weeks, adjusting weights each time. Standings use cumulative risk-adjusted return with a penalty for deep dips.
hook: Long arc makes each weekly session feel consequential.
risk: Weekly cadence is gentle but can create fear of missing a week.

name: Panic Button
loop: A crash replays in slow motion with news-like generic captions. Hold to stay invested, release to exit. The reveal shows your exit versus the eventual recovery and versus the further fall.
hook: Shows the fear in your own hands, with no scoring shame.
risk: Crisis replay may be distressing; opt-in framing and neutral tone.

name: Beta Budget
loop: Each card has a swing rating and a hidden return. Draft cards until the deck swing total hits the cap, then the compressed year plays. Wise decks use the cap fully without correlated blowups.
hook: Resource cap makes every draft pick matter.
risk: Hidden returns drawn from past data; ensure no peeking leaks.

name: Exit Plan Writer
loop: Before the replay begins, commit to a stop, a target and a time limit on a masked position. The plan executes automatically with no overrides. Score is how well the plan fit the path versus a random plan.
hook: Rewards plan quality, not twitchy reaction.
risk: Plans scored on one path; compare to a distribution of plans.

name: Cash Is A Position
loop: Two masked assets and a cash slider. Idle cash earns a small rate, so sitting out is a legal move. Sharpe-like scoring means doing nothing cannot win but cannot lose badly either.
hook: Dignifies cash and shows the risk-reward grid of inaction.
risk: Cash rate is fictitious; label it as a game constant.

name: Fold Rate
loop: Twenty open masked positions, each shown with its current paper gain. Swipe to hold or fold; afterwards the app measures whether your fold calls beat the forward path more than chance.
hook: A single stat tells you if you cut winners too early.
risk: Small samples per session produce noisy stats; accumulate over days.

name: Liquidity Squeeze
loop: Some generated assets are thin: exiting large paper size moves price against you. Spread size across liquid and thin assets, then survive three forced-exit events with the best average exit.
hook: A mechanic few intros teach; replays reveal edge cases.
risk: Teaching liquidity could invite small-cap talk; keep assets generic.

name: Equity Curve Duel
loop: Two friends allocate the same masked basket. Instead of ending return, the winner is whoever has the smoother equity curve with at least equal growth. Reveal overlays both curves.
hook: Smoothness wins; unusual victory condition starts debates.
risk: Peer comparison may promote sizing contests; keep friends-only.

name: Slow Bleed Test
loop: A generated path drifts down slowly with small bounces. Hold to wait for a recovery or release to cut. The reveal compares the cut point to the final level and to alternate drift paths.
hook: Captures the quiet, hard decision of slow losses.
risk: Alternate paths may imply recoveries always follow; show both.

name: Weekend Allocator
loop: Today's single masked month with three assets. Set weights once with a budget of 100 and share an emoji-like heat strip of your equity curve, no numbers shown.
hook: Tiny daily ritual with a spoiler-free share strip.
risk: Daily streak pressure; do not reward streaks.

name: Scale In Ladder
loop: Tap to scale into a masked paper position in up to four steps while the path runs. Average entry and risk bar update live; the reveal compares your ladder to all-in and to waiting.
hook: Small taps, visible average price, quick lesson on entry timing.
risk: Entry-timing lessons may imply timing skill; show random baseline.

name: Risk Budget Draft
loop: Pick strategy cards such as wide stops, small sizes or diversified bundles within a risk budget. All players face the same seeded synthetic year. Ranking shows how deck choices fared overall.
hook: Meta-game of which risk rules win in a seeded world.
risk: Synthetic seed worlds can favor one rule by design; rotate seeds.

name: Verified Drawdown Detective
loop: Watch anonymised verified equity curves unfold; before the worst stretch plays, guess how deep it goes from five bands. Reveal explains how wide drawdowns are normal for good records.
hook: Builds realistic expectations that fit the app's trust ethos.
risk: Anonymised bands must stay coarse to avoid identification.

name: Sleep Test
loop: Set the largest paper loss you could stomach, then play a masked year at the sizing implied. A comfort meter reacts to how close the real path came to your stated limit.
hook: Personal, reflective and surprisingly revealing.
risk: Could read as a suitability questionnaire; avoid advice language.

name: Cascade
loop: Stack paper positions on a rising generated market; each swipe right adds one and raises the multiplier. A cascade of correlated falls wipes the stack. Bank before it breaks.
hook: Push-your-luck stacking with a satisfying wipeout.
risk: Streak multiplier rewards frequency of risk; highly compulsion-prone.

name: Hedge Pair Match
loop: From six masked charts, pick the pair whose combination had the lowest swing over the replayed year. Hit or miss is revealed along with each pair's combined curve.
hook: Tidy puzzle that quietly teaches correlation.
risk: Pairs are history only; avoid implying future behavior.

name: Max Pain Meter
loop: See the first half of an anonymised verified record. Set your probability that the max per-trade drawdown in the second half exceeds a threshold; Brier scoring rewards honest odds.
hook: Calibration on a real quantity the app already shows.
risk: Using record halves could leak a trader's identity; use composites.

name: Run To Zero
loop: Start with ten paper points and an ever-nastier set of generated regimes. Each regime asks for a new allocation; survival multiplies a score by regime difficulty. Death ends the run with a cause-of-death card.
hook: Cause-of-death cards are funny and educational.
risk: Death theatrics may trivialize loss; keep tone light but not celebratory.

name: Stop Or Wait Slider
loop: For a masked position set the probability that the stop will be hit before the target. Log scoring rewards sharp honest numbers; a running chart shows your calibration curve over days.
hook: Mix of probability and risk thinking in a 90-second sitting.
risk: Calibration curve from few trials is noisy; show uncertainty.

name: Mean Reversion Orchard
loop: Plant paper positions in a garden of generated assets by dragging size ranges. Assets grow, wilt or swing; you tend by resizing. The garden visual shows risk concentrations as overgrown plots.
hook: Gentle garden visuals make allocation feel calm and visual.
risk: Cute skin may mask real-money-like risk; keep numbers visible.

name: Final Hour Scramble
loop: Before delayed prices resolve overnight, set paper weights across five names shown with real tickers hidden until resolution. Score is next-day paper return against the field, with a risk penalty.
hook: Real stakes of time passing; wake up to a result.
risk: Delayed live use must stay paper and non-advisory; tickers hidden until after.

name: Anchor Bias Bath
loop: Set a plausible range for next month's move on a masked chart, with a decoy earlier peak flagged on screen. The score reveals whether you anchored to the decoy.
hook: Bias-hunting meta quiz gives aha moments.
risk: Decoy manipulation may feel tricky; reveal the design afterwards.

name: Portfolio Heat Map
loop: A heat map of six masked assets shows month-by-month moves as a grid replay. Allocate before it plays and see which cells hurt; the codex unlocks regime names after each reveal.
hook: Visual grid makes risk look like weather.
risk: Regime names are labels not predictions; state that.

name: Tournament Of Sizes
loop: All entrants face one seeded synthetic path per week and choose only their size fraction. Rankings split into size classes so cautious and bold players each have a podium.
hook: Fair classes keep careful players engaged.
risk: Classes labeled bold may encourage risk-seeking; balance wording.

name: Stoploss Shoot Out
loop: Challenge a friend: same masked position, each drags a stop and a target in secret. Both plans run on the path, and the better paper result wins. Replays show where each stop would have triggered.
hook: Easy to send and finish in a minute.
risk: Unlimited rematches could escalate; add a cooldown.

name: Four Seasons Portfolio
loop: A four-act story of one masked year, one act per season. Reallocate between acts with a limited number of moves; the epilogue shows alternative allocations and what the year was.
hook: Narrative arc with a reveal at the end.
risk: Epilogue alternatives may imply hindsight is skill; add caveat.

name: Burn Rate
loop: Your paper account pays a running cost each second, so waiting is not free. Hold positions long enough to cover costs but release before reversals; survive 12 cost-laden stages.
hook: Introduces carrying cost as a living pressure.
risk: Continuous cost drain is a pressure mechanic; keep it gentle.

name: Mirror Portfolio
loop: Two anonymised verified record summaries are shown with sizing buckets, win rate and loss depth. Choose which had the larger worst stretch. Trains reading dispersion in real data.
hook: Short clean puzzle with a real-data flavor.
risk: Record summaries must avoid ranking individuals; use composites.

name: Rolling Dice Versus Rolling Years
loop: Run the same strategy slider through one lucky path, then through a thousand paths, and compare. A split-screen shows how much of a result is luck, ending with a luck-share meter.
hook: One-minute demonstration of variance versus skill.
risk: Skill versus luck model is simplistic; call it illustration.

name: Triple Threshold
loop: Each floor offers three masked setups with a risk label only. Pick one and set size; then the replay plays. Pass floors by keeping loss inside the per-floor limit regardless of win or loss.
hook: Rewards limiting loss, not hitting wins.
risk: Risk labels from past data could mislead; flag as historical.

name: Margin Call Mode
loop: A leveraged paper account on a generated path: higher leverage gains faster and gets forced out at a threshold. Survive to the end with the most paper equity; a ghost shows the safest route.
hook: Everyone wants to push leverage, then sees the cliff.
risk: Leverage mechanics are a bold idea; may normalize leverage. Needs panel veto.

name: Correlation Surprise
loop: Two masked assets are shown; estimate the probability both fall on the same stress day. Brier scoring tallies; reveals show how often supposedly different assets fell together.
hook: Counterintuitive facts delivered as score feedback.
risk: Stress-day stats rely on chosen windows; disclose sample.

name: Peak To Trough Pacing
loop: A compressed masked path scrolls; tap to mark where you would rebalance. Dots appear on the curve, then the reveal shows peak-to-trough zones and your marks against them.
hook: Visual pacing practice with no wrong answers, only tendencies.
risk: Marking peaks and troughs encourages timing fantasies.

name: Council Of Positions
loop: A group of friends co-manage one paper pool: each member controls one asset slider. The pool plays a compressed year; group score is risk-adjusted, so cooperation on risk is the game.
hook: Social deduction of who is overexposing the team.
risk: Group pressure to take risk; show everyone's contribution neutrally.

name: Winner Trap
loop: A paper position doubles early. Swipe to sell half, all or none at each chapter. The ending reveals what happened afterwards in three branches drawn from similar historical setups.
hook: Embodies the sell-too-soon versus too-late dilemma.
risk: Branches from similar setups are a small sample; label as examples.

name: Max Loss Lottery Ticket
loop: Choose between small steady paper gains or rare large payoffs on generated paths. Many rounds reveal that the lottery choice usually ends in ruin while a steady one compounds.
hook: Makes expected value feel real via dozens of quick rounds.
risk: Lottery-like framing is risky for compulsion; heavy caution.

name: Paper Prop Desk
loop: Climb desk tiers by staying inside a drawdown limit across weeks of masked sessions. Breaching the limit sends you down a tier; rank shows consistency over raw return.
hook: Career ladder motivates discipline over heroics.
risk: Prop-desk framing might hint at real funded trading; avoid that wording.

name: Slippage Savvy
loop: Set how often to trade on a generated path where each trade costs a small fee. The net curve shows frequency eating returns; sliders compare patient and busy styles side by side.
hook: Fast proof that churning hurts, fitting the app's no-frequency-rewards rule.
risk: None major; ensure fees are labelled as game constants.

name: Rotation Roulette Deck
loop: Each turn draw a masked asset card and decide: keep it in your hand of five, or swap it for the next draw. After five turns a compressed year plays and the diversified hand scores best.
hook: Draw-and-keep tension with a diversification payoff.
risk: Roulette in the name and draw mechanics echo gambling; rename or tone down.

name: Lifeline Portfolio
loop: You have three lifelines: cut all, halve, or freeze for one month. Use them at the right moments across a masked two-year run; unused lifelines count for bonus points.
hook: Limited emergency tools give strategic arc to a single run.
risk: Unused-lifeline bonus may promote doing nothing; keep balanced.

name: Wipeout Rewind
loop: When a run ends in ruin the game rewinds to the last moment you could have changed course and asks you to pick a different size. Fix three wipeouts to complete the codex entry.
hook: Learning from failure is the loop, not a penalty.
risk: Rewind might feel like infinite retries; limit per day.

name: Hedge Or Not Hand
loop: Each round shows a drop warning. Swipe to hedge part of the paper book or not; the opponent ghost makes the same call from a previous player. The path then plays and the better equity takes the round.
hook: Short head-to-head rounds with instant feedback.
risk: Rapid rounds are compulsion-prone; cap daily rounds.

name: Skill Or Luck Test
loop: Weekly set of twenty masked baskets. Your total is compared with a distribution of random allocations to give a skill percentile with an honest interval on a few dozen weeks.
hook: A rating that admits uncertainty is novel and credible.
risk: Percentile of random allocations is not a market skill measure; explain.

name: Rainy Day Fund
loop: A masked decade includes two paper life events that demand cash. Keep a reserve slider to meet them without selling at lows; score penalizes forced sales and rewards growth of the rest.
hook: Relatable life-planning story in the sim.
risk: Planning framing may read as personal finance advice; keep fictional.

name: Risk Reveal Cards
loop: Each card shows a verified record's headline stats in anonymised form; choose which of three labels, such as steady, streaky or fat-tailed, fits. Answers teach how record shapes differ.
hook: Quick learning on reading the app's own profiles.
risk: Labels risk stereotyping; keep anonymised and non-judgmental.

name: Equity Tide
loop: Spectators watch another player's live paper replay and tap to cheer or doubt each rebalance. At the end the app shows whether crowd doubt beat crowd cheer on risk-adjusted outcomes.
hook: Watching others' decisions is a relaxed, communal mode.
risk: Crowd sentiment could become signal-like; hide until resolved.

name: Sizing Tarot
loop: Pull a daily risk card that sets a constraint, such as max two positions or stops must be wide. Play a short generated run under it and collect the card art after clearing it.
hook: Daily constraint keeps familiar play fresh.
risk: Tarot flavour suggests fortune telling; rename to constraint cards.

name: Withdrawal Walk
loop: A masked multi-decade path while you draw a fixed paper income each year. Pick an allocation and a withdrawal rate; survive as long as the pot lasts. The reveal shows lasting years versus alternative eras.
hook: A different, long-horizon survival puzzle.
risk: Withdrawal sims could read as retirement advice; keep fictional.

name: Overnight Parcel
loop: Before the close, split a small paper stake and a probability across three masked tickers for tomorrow. Resolution tomorrow blends Brier on direction and paper return with a drawdown cap.
hook: A morning checking ritual that rewards honest odds.
risk: Daily live prediction can become habit; no streak rewards.

name: Cost Of Being Right Late
loop: Drag your entry window on a masked chart after seeing an early hint of trend. Entering late captures less and risks more; the reveal charts gain by entry timing as a curve.
hook: The curve of lateness is one clean aha.
risk: Hindsight chart may imply early entry is knowable; caveat.

name: Stop Casino
loop: A pure bold idea: generated bets with ever larger multipliers; each cash-out locks paper points, and a hidden stop can end the ride. The debrief shows expected value per choice.
hook: Naked push-your-luck with an EV debrief.
risk: Directly gambling-shaped; likely reject but included to test the panel.

name: Quarter Compass
loop: Four quarters, four masked baskets, one set of weights per quarter. A compass-like radar shows return, swing, drawdown and consistency, and friends can try the same year to compare radars.
hook: Radar comparison gives personal style feedback.
risk: Style labels may be mistaken for advice; keep descriptive.

name: Tilt Shield
loop: After two paper losses the game forces a cooling pause with a breathing animation, then lets you resize. Players who pause voluntarily before the forced one earn shield bonuses.
hook: Rewards self-regulation; unusual and kind.
risk: Enforced pauses might annoy; make skippable with trade-off.

name: Basket Case
loop: Friends toss assets into a shared basket in turns; each sees only part of the others' picks. Once full, a compressed year plays and the group sees which hidden picks cost them.
hook: Funny, social and low pressure.
risk: Social pressure to chase hot picks; assets stay masked.

name: Long Short Seesaw
loop: Balance paper longs against paper shorts across masked names to keep net exposure near zero while still earning; a seesaw graphic tilts with net exposure and the replay tests the balance.
hook: A balance toy that makes net exposure intuitive.
risk: Shorting introduces unlimited-loss ideas; cap and explain.

name: Timeframe Tumbler
loop: The same masked asset is shown over week, year and decade windows. Choose the holding horizon at which your stop would have survived; the reveal shows how stops fare by horizon.
hook: Quick perspective game on horizon versus noise.
risk: Single asset examples; label as illustrations.

name: Season Of Restraint
loop: The season ranks the fewest rebalances achieving a target risk-adjusted return across weekly masked years. Doing less is the point; leaders earn a restraint badge.
hook: Reverse of an activity grind; fits the product's no-frequency-reward rule.
risk: Badge for inactivity might be misread; make it about quality.

name: Verified Replay Relay
loop: Watch an anonymised verified sequence of closed trades with names stripped. Before each result, say whether the trader sized up or down after the last loss; reveals show sizing behavior patterns.
hook: Psychology of real traders, with no personal identity.
risk: Re-identification and implied judgement of individuals; composites only.

name: Floor And Ceiling
loop: Drag a floor and a ceiling for portfolio value; the game auto-reduces risk near the floor and lets it run near the ceiling. Replays show how rules shape outcomes across random paths.
hook: Rule-making toy: design a rule then watch it live.

name: Ninety Second Career
loop: A whole trading career of forty years of masked history compressed into 90 seconds. Reallocate at five life stages; the career epitaph summarizes survival, drawdown and restraint.
hook: Epic time compression with a shareable epitaph.
risk: Career framing may suggest trading as livelihood; keep playful.
